column7: A correct password on an MFA account plus a CreateMFAChallenge storage error answered 500 where a wrong password answered 401 (an oracle for the password), and buildLoginResponse/VerifyMFA/step-up had the same shape. The login handler now answers the wrong-credential response and counts toward lockout (RecordPostVerdictLoginFailure); the other three sites are pinned by TestVerifyMFA_PostVerdictFaultCostsTheSameAsAWrongCode (login-identity-read-panic row, #3267) and TestReauthEndpoints_PreVerdictStorageFaultIsIdenticalToAWrongCode (reauth-fault-parity-001, #2894). Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
